title: Lifting a projective-bundle fibre isomorphism as a morphism
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a quasi-coherent finite locally free module of constant rank r >= 2 [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and p:P(E)->S the canonical symmetric-algebra relative Proj [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Let M,N be invertible modules on P(E) [def-sc-invertible-module], and s a point of S. Assume the tensor-formula pullbacks of M,N to the residue-field fibre at s are isomorphic [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist an open U containing s and a morphism phi:M|p^{-1}(U)->N|p^{-1}(U) such that its tensor-formula pullback along the fibre inclusion of p|U at the point (s,s in U) is an isomorphism. No invertibility of phi over p^{-1}(U) itself is asserted.

source.place: lemma-perfect-direct-image and remark-explain-perfect-direct-image (Noetherian fibre-section lifting), combined with limits.tex lemma-descend-invertible-modules and finite-presentation map descent; EGA II Remark 4.2.7 announces the related classification.

proof.text: Restrict to an affine base neighbourhood trivializing E. Quotient geometry identifies its bundle with projective space. First suppose the base ring is Noetherian. Put F=M dual tensor N; the fibre isomorphism gives F_s isomorphic to O and a generator of it. The projection is proper and flat, by polynomial charts, and F is flat over the base. Its trivial fibre has H^1=0 by projective-space cohomology. Lift the fibre generator by proper flat fibre-section lifting. Tensor-Hom duality converts the lifted section into a morphism from M to N. Under the canonical identifications its pullback to the restricted projection fibre is the given isomorphism, hence invertible. This step does not prove invertibility on the neighbourhood.

source.place: lemma-perfect-direct-image and remark-explain-perfect-direct-image (Noetherian fibre-section lifting), combined with limits.tex lemma-descend-invertible-modules and finite-presentation map descent; EGA II Remark 4.2.7 announces the related classification.

proof.text: For an arbitrary affine ring A, express Spec A as the limit of its finite-type integer approximations. The corresponding projective spaces are qcqs with affine transitions and the expected limit. Descend M and N to a common Noetherian stage. The original fibre is the limit of the residue-field fibres at the image points. Finite-presentation isomorphism descent places the fibre isomorphism and its inverse at a later stage. Apply the Noetherian lifting step there, and pull its open and morphism back. Compatibility with fibre products and pullback composition identifies the fibre pullback with a pullback of an isomorphism. View the resulting open inside the original S. No removal of the non-isomorphism locus is performed.

lean.statement:
theorem projective_bundle_fiber_hom_lift (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (M N : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj.Modules)
    (hM : M.IsInvertible) (hN : N.IsInvertible) (s : S)
    (e : Nonempty
      ((tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom.fiberι s)).obj M ≅
        (tensorPullback
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom.fiberι s)).obj N)) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (hs : s ∈ U)
      (φ : (tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M ⟶
        (tensorPullback
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj N),
      IsIso ((tensorPullback
        (((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ∣_ U).fiberι
          (⟨s, hs⟩ : U.toScheme))).map φ)
